sql: WITH receita_corrente AS (SELECT SUM(CAST(vlr_realizadoateperiodo AS DECIMAL)) AS total_receita FROM receita_receita WHERE ano_referencia = 2025 AND COALESCE(dsc_cateconomica, '') ILIKE '%Corrente%'), despesa_camara AS (SELECT SUM(CAST(vlr_liquidado AS DECIMAL)) AS total_despesa FROM despesa_despesa WHERE ano_referencia = 2025 AND CAST(cod_orgao AS INTEGER) = 1) SELECT (CAST(d.total_despesa AS DECIMAL) / NULLIF(r.total_receita, 0)) * 100 AS porcentagem FROM receita_corrente r, despesa_camara d;
